outcome: rate of incomplete fetal anatomy exams
rate of missing measurements for nuchal fold
rate of missing measurements for nose bone length
rate of inadequate views of certain anatomy elements
cohort: The study included 15,723 detailed fetal anatomy exams from singleton pregnancies with cardiac activity, performed at seven maternal-fetal medicine practices at 18.0 to 23.9 weeks of gestation.
finding: The rate of incomplete fetal anatomy exams varied significantly between different maternal-fetal medicine practices and individual examiners, with maternal obesity, prior cesarean, maternal age < 35 years, and GA < 19 weeks being associated with higher rates.
mod_finding: Incomplete exams were significantly more common among mothers with a prior cesarean section.
